title: Age of open job postings on company job boards, November 2026

method.source: The ATS Jobs Search job index built at 2026-11-19T04:03:40.394Z from employers' public job feeds on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Recruitee, Personio and Workable.
method.age: Days from the posting time in the vendor's feed to the index build. Posting time fields: Greenhouse first_published; Lever createdAt; Ashby publishedAt; Recruitee published_at (else created_at); Personio createdAt; Workable published_on (else created_at), a date without a time (Workable gives a date without a time, read as 00:00 UTC).
method.older_than: Older than N days = posted N or more days before the build.
method.snapshot: Every figure describes the jobs open at the build. Postings that opened and closed before it are not in the index, so long-lived postings are over-represented compared with all postings ever made: these are ages of open postings, not how long postings stay up.
method.cohorts: Open listings by week of posting, each week against the last 7 days. If employers posted the same number of jobs every week, the ratio would be the share of postings still up that many weeks after they went up. Changes in how many jobs were posted each week move it too.
method.copies: A job with the same title, location and posting time on two or more boards of one ATS is counted once, on the board that lists it most often (as on the posting-day page).
method.invalid_times: A posting time before 1 Jan 2000 (a zero timestamp) is treated as missing and the job is left out.
method.reposting_boards: Boards with 50 or more open listings, none posted 14 or more days before the build, re-date their listings; they are left out of the weekly cohorts only.
method.pools: A talent pool or general application: the title matches general application|open application|spontaneous application|unsolicited application|speculative application|initiativbewerbung|blindbewerbung|open sollicitatie|candidature spontan|candidatura espont|talent (?:pool|community|network)|future (?:opportunit|role|opening|position|vacanc)|don.?t see (?:a|the|your|what)|didn.?t find|not listed|can.?t find (?:a|the|your)|general interest|expression of interest|join our team(?: anyway)?$|always hiring
method.groups: Role groups come from keyword rules on the whole title; the first rule that matches wins. Short forms (AI, HR, IT, PR, RN...) count only in capitals.
method.seniority: Seniority words from ct-003/build_data.py's rule (senior, staff, lead, head, director...; junior, intern, student, graduate, trainee...).
method.region: From the location text, with ct-002/build_data.py's rule: US, Europe, or other.
method.board_weighted: board_median_days is the median over boards of each board's median listing age, so each board counts once.
